description: Main entry point for the Goteo web application; initializes configuration, sets up error handling, request object, and starts the application server.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Handles HTTP request data; used to create the request object from global PHP variables.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration handler; loads settings from a YAML file and manages configuration options.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application class; manages application state, services, and execution.

methods.name: Request::createFromGlobals
methods.description: Creates a new Request object based on PHP globals.

methods.name: Config::load
methods.description: Loads configuration settings from a given file.

methods.name: Config::autosave
methods.description: Enables automatic saving of configuration changes.

methods.name: App::setRequest
methods.description: Sets the current request object within the application.

methods.name: App::run
methods.description: Starts the application's main request handling loop.
